description: Merge PDF. Join several PDF files into one, in the order you picked. Nothing is re-rendered: pages are copied as they are. Accepts application/pdf, .pdf; up to 100 MB per file.

keepMetadata.description: Carry the title and author of the first document over to the result

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: pdf_merge
